column1: # Registry of the secrets this machine needs. No value ever lives here.
# Each secret is stored in the login keychain under its own variable name, with
# the current user as the account, which is what .zshrc reads back:
# `setup secrets` walks this file: it fills what is missing, and rotates on demand.
# Columns are tab separated: VARIABLE, where to get it, what it is for, recovery.
# The recovery column is the one that matters, and it has two values:
#   regenerate  revoke it and create a new one, the old value is worthless
#   critical    it cannot be recreated: it decrypts data that exists nowhere else.
#               `setup secrets` asks these twice and compares, because storing a
#               typo would look fine and only fail later, at signing time.
